mutations.description: Accept an empty device path instead of rejecting it before OS setup.
Create the signal wake pipe without nonblocking behavior.
Open the serial device without nonblocking behavior.
Wake the service from a signal without publishing the stop request.
Set the stop flag but skip the async-signal-safe self-pipe write.
Return from the signal handler without restoring the interrupted errno value.
Install handlers with SA_RESTART instead of leaving blocking calls interruptible.
Install the second handler for SIGINT again and leave SIGTERM unchanged.
Configure 9600 baud instead of the required 115200 baud.
Leave canonical line processing enabled on the serial device.
mutations.find:
attributes.c_lflag &= (tcflag_t)~(
    ECHO |
    ECHONL |
    ICANON |
    ISIG |
    IEXTEN
  );

mutations.description: Configure seven data bits instead of raw 8N1.
Retry a permanent permission failure instead of returning an OS error.
mutations.replace:
return error_number == EACCES ||
    error_number == ENOENT ||
    error_number == ENODEV ||

mutations.description: Start reconnect delays at 200 ms instead of 100 ms.
Allow reconnect delays to grow beyond the 1600 ms cap.
Keep the maximum delay after a successful connection.
Treat an unexpected self-pipe event during reconnect wait as graceful shutdown.
Ignore terminal self-pipe events while the serial device is connected.
Leave a hung-up device connected instead of entering reconnect backoff.
Turn a transient nonblocking read into a terminal OS error.
mutations.find:
errno != EAGAIN &&
          errno != EWOULDBLOCK &&
          errno != EINTR
mutations.replace:
errno == EAGAIN ||
          errno != EWOULDBLOCK ||
          errno != EINTR

mutations.description: Continue service operation after the downstream consumer rejects data.
Process ready serial data even after the signal stop flag is observed.
Read only half of the declared bounded chunk on each readiness event.
mutations.find: const ssize_t count = read(serial_fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer));
mutations.replace: const ssize_t count = read(serial_fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer) / 2u);

mutations.description: Keep an EOF device connected instead of reconnecting.
Restore SIGINT twice and leave the previous SIGTERM action displaced.
